reason: I have a freelancer I trust for copy and I'd just call them. Paying 55 to run a contest where most entries get nothing, on an unaudited new platform paid in USDC, is more hassle than a small task is worth.
objection: The 10% fee plus the reward is more than I would spend on a small task, and I'd have to set up USDC on Solana for a platform nobody I know has used.
would_change_my_mind: A colleague or a freelancer I already trust vouching for it, and being able to pay by card instead of USDC.
